messages:
maria_support: Hey team, urgent — wire for invoice INV-9921 (Novacorp) failed with a correspondent bank rejection. Customer is on hold and asking for ETA.
kevin_payments: Can you paste the payment id + any SWIFT notes?
maria_support: payment_id: pay_01G7X9Z4A8, amount: $142,500 USD. Rails: SWIFT MT103 via FirstEast Bank (FEBAUS33). Bank return note: 'UNKNOWN_CORRESPONDENT - Beneficiary bank not known to correspondent'.
kevin_payments: ugh. That typically means intermediary/correspondent list mismatch. Do we have the MT103 UETR/trace id from outbound?
maria_support: Trace/MT103: 97A9-3F1B-44C2. Attached bank-notify message: 
```
Swift-Note: /REJ/BNK-NOTKNOWN
Intermediary: FirstEast Bank (FEBAUS33)
Beneficiary BIC: NVCBGB2L
Beneficiary acct: ****6789
```
kevin_payments: Please run: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/payments/pay_01G7X9Z4A8
```
and paste the payment JSON (mask acct numbers).
maria_support: pasted: 
```json
{
  "id":"pay_01G7X9Z4A8",
  "amount":"142500",
  "currency":"USD",
  "rails":"swift",
  "beneficiary_bic":"NVCBGB2L",
  "intermediary_bic":"FEBAUS33",
  "status":"returned",
  "bank_notes":["UNKNOWN_CORRESPONDENT - Beneficiary bank not known to correspondent"],
  "created_at":"2026-11-03T14:02:02Z"
}
```
alex_bank_relations: tagging @kevin_payments — looks like FEBAUS33 did not have a nostro/ledger relationship with NVCBGB2L for USD, so the payment couldn't be routed. Two options: 1) resubmit via alternate correspondent (GlobalCorrUS / GLBCUS44) or 2) ask customer bank to update their beneficiary BIC/intermediary chain.
kevin_payments: I can attempt reroute. Any compliance blockers? KYC for GlobalCorrUS already on file for Novacorp?
alex_bank_relations: Compliance check is green (we did KYC on 2025-09-10). Reroute recommended. Need MT103 copy + instruct sending bank to include full beneficiary address in tag 59 and provide the intervening correspondent in tag 56 if required.
maria_support: Customer is asking for fastest fix. They prefer we re-process on our side if possible. Can payments ops re-initiate?
kevin_payments: I'll spin a retry via GlobalCorrUS. Creating internal task now. Anyone have a short note for the bank ticket?
alex_bank_relations: Use this: "Request urgent investigation of returned MT103 UETR 97A9-3F1B-44C2. Return reason: UNKNOWN_CORRESPONDENT. Please confirm whether FEBAUS33 maintains nostro for NVCBGB2L for USD. If not, advise primary correspondent used by FEBAUS33 or accept reroute via GLBCUS44. Please attach MT103 copy and advise corrective measures (resubmit or provide required intermediary)."
kevin_payments: created task PAYOPS-4127, attempted reroute at 14:18 UTC. Payload used (masked): 
```json
{"id":"pay_01G7X9Z4A8","intermediary_bic":"GLBCUS44","instructions":"include beneficiary address in tag 59"}
```
bank-notify-bot: ALERT: payment pay_01G7X9Z4A8 reroute submitted to GlobalCorrUS at 2026-11-03T14:18:23Z.
maria_support: forwarded to customer with note that we're reprocessing and will update within 2 business hours. They acknowledged :thumbsup:.
kevin_payments: Update: GlobalCorrUS accepted the MT103 and forwarded to beneficiary bank. Status changed to 'processing' at 14:24 UTC.
bank-notify-bot: NOTICE: payment pay_01G7X9Z4A8 cleared by beneficiary bank at 14:31 UTC. Settlement trace: ST-88421.
maria_support: Customer notified payment cleared. They confirmed receipt at 14:46 UTC. Closing ticket.
kevin_payments: Postmortem notes: - Add validation to check common correspondent coverage for BIC pairs before submit. - If 'UNKNOWN_CORRESPONDENT' appears, auto-suggest alternate correspondent mapping (internal lookup). - Log the MT103 UETR in payment events for faster bank escalations.
alex_bank_relations: I'll open a follow-up with FEBAUS33 to confirm correspondent network and request they add a preferred correspondent for NVCBGB2L to reduce future failures.
maria_support: closing thread. Filing internal support case SUP-7793 with full logs and MT103 copy. :white_check_mark:
